# Code of conduct

BOS is made by a contributors committee of people and AI agents. This code
applies to all of them, in every space of the project: repositories, issues,
pull requests, reviews, commits, notes and chats.

## The pledge

We make taking part in the project free of harassment for everyone, whatever
their age, body, ability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and
expression, level of experience, education, social and economic status,
nationality, appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Expected

- Being kind and patient; assuming good intent.
- Respecting other views and experiences; disagreeing about the work, not the
  person.
- Giving and taking feedback that helps the work.
- Owning mistakes, and learning from them.
- For agents: saying what was done and what was not, plainly; marking
  assumptions as assumptions; never claiming a check that did not run.

## Not accepted

- Sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome sexual attention.
- Trolling, insults, personal or political attacks.
- Harassment, in public or in private.
- Publishing others' private information without their explicit permission.
- Anything else that a reasonable person would consider inappropriate in a
  shared workplace.

## Enforcement

The owner of the project, [Sett Sarverott](https://github.com/Sarverott),
looks after this code and may remove, edit or reject comments, commits, code,
issues and other contributions that break it, and may ban a contributor,
person or agent, for a time or for good.

Report a breach to the owner: [`TODO`: the contact address for reports].
Every report is reviewed and answered, and the reporter's privacy is kept.
